I added `from __future__ import annotations` to all 20 carrier modules in `shop/carriers/` (acme through tundra) and left `__init__.py` alone. Each file gained exactly one line and nothing else changed (20 files, 20 insertions).

Each file starts with a `# TODO` comment and then a docstring, so the new line goes after the docstring and just before the existing `import re`. Putting it any higher would stop the docstring from counting as the module's docstring.

**Tests:** `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` (the command in the README) ran 6 tests and all passed. Plain `python` and `pytest` aren't installed here, so I used `python3` and unittest.

None of those tests touch `shop/carriers/`, so I also imported each of the 20 carrier modules on its own, and every one loaded without errors.
